## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api failed health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (18% error rate, unhealthy in all regions).

**Actions taken:**
1. Checked deployment history — confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest release (unhealthy) and **v2.3.0** was the most recent release healthy in production.
2. Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0. The first rollback attempt failed partway (us-east only), so I verified state and retried; the second attempt completed the rollout.
3. Verified recovery: all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) now run v2.3.0, service is **healthy**, error rate back to ~0.2%.
4. Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions") documenting the failure, rollback, and verification — on-call has been paged.

**Follow-up:** v2.3.1 (and its staging predecessor v2.3.1-rc) should be investigated before any re-deploy.
